items.title: Fact-Checking at Scale: Building a More Accurate and Efficient Synopsis Factuality System
items.d: Netflix automatically checks synopses of its shows for factual errors. Its new factuality service cuts cost per synopsis by 52.4% and raises recall on non-factual synopses from 0.77 to 0.86. Its explanations now overlap about 82% with human annotators' reasoning, up from about 69%.
